ONNX Runtime Web modified by LineLight
======================================

Package version: 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4
Upstream commit: 89f8206ba4f1c22c39e0297fb55272e8ce8cd7d0
LineLight patch SHA-256: 4b368d00b9c4fc11cf5183caeed13d858e93b842cba26df27bde1b653d9372f2
Modification date: 2026-08-09

LineLight changed ONNX Runtime Web for Issue #55 to add a generation-scoped,
cooperative cancellation mailbox and WebAssembly bridge for serialized
multi-threaded offline narration inference. The bridge preserves the warm
model session after an acknowledged canceled run.

ONNX Runtime and LineLight's modifications are provided under the MIT License
in LICENSE. Licenses and notices for incorporated third-party components are
provided in ThirdPartyNotices.txt. The exact source patch, build procedure,
artifact checksums, and SPDX SBOM are distributed in LineLight under
vendor/onnxruntime-web/.
